device.modelDescription: Access module of the ch-packs family: reads GitHub Actions runs, failed jobs, job logs and commit authors through GitHub's MCP server, declared as the remote 'github'. The token is the runtime's: this module never sees it.

actionList.name: listRuns
actionList.description: The repository's most recent workflow runs, newest first, every workflow: run id, GitHub's conclusion (null while in progress), head commit, branch, time, workflow name and URL. Never a commit author's name or email.

actionList.name: failedJobs
actionList.description: A run's jobs that failed or timed out, every page of them, each with every step's name and conclusion.

actionList.name: jobLog
actionList.description: A job's whole log as text with its line and byte counts. A log past GitHub's retention or gone (410/404) answers expired: true with no text, not an error; truncated says the server returned fewer lines than the log has. Any other failure is the error LOG_UNAVAILABLE.

actionList.name: runCommits
actionList.description: A commit's author as a GitHub login (null when the commit is not tied to an account). Never a name or an email.
